BORDER_STYLE_TOOLTIP: The frame drawn around the square minimap.
BORDER_COLOR_TOOLTIP: Tints the border. "Natural" keeps the texture's own colors.
MAP_SCALE_TOOLTIP: Scales the minimap and everything attached to it.
LOADED: v%s loaded. Type %s to open the settings.
CONFLICT_TEXT:
%s also changes the minimap. Both at once will fight over it.

Which one do you want to keep?
CONFLICT_TEXT_UNKNOWN:
Another addon changes the minimap too. Both at once will fight over it.

Keep Ordaen Minimap, or turn it off?
CONFLICT_OVERRIDE_HINT: keeping Ordaen Minimap. If %s has its own minimap options (shape, border), turn them off there.
CONFLICT_LATER_HINT: Ordaen Minimap stays off until the next login, where it asks again.
DRAWER_ENABLED_TOOLTIP: Collects other addons' minimap buttons and addon compartment entries behind one small button. Turning it off needs a /reload to put the buttons back on the map.
HIDE_BLIZZARD_COMPARTMENT_TOOLTIP: Hides Blizzard's addon compartment button; its entries are in the drawer.
DRAWER_COLUMNS_TOOLTIP: How many buttons per row in the drawer.
DRAWER_TOOLTIP_CLICK: Left-click: open or close the drawer
DRAWER_TOOLTIP_MOVE: Drag: move it around the minimap
DRAWER_MBB_WARNING: MinimapButtonButton is loaded, so the button drawer stays off (both would grab the same buttons). Disable one of them.
DRAWER_RELOAD_HINT: button drawer off. Type /reload to put the buttons back on the minimap.
